title: Parse CSV with quoted fields
prompt: Implement parseCSV(text) in csv.js, returning an array of rows, each an array of strings. Fields are separated by commas and rows by \n or \r\n. A field may be quoted with double quotes; a quoted field can contain commas, line breaks and doubled quotes ("" stands for one "). Empty fields are kept, whitespace is kept as is, and a line break at the very end does not add an empty row. Empty input returns []. An unterminated quoted field throws a SyntaxError. Do not change test.js.
